content: Akasɩ́pʋ́ Amʋ Ayabiasɩ Fwɩ
Asa béfi Israelfɔsʋ Katsʋn Nkɛ ámʋ gyí asɩ á, Yesu lɛ́bɩ ánɩ́ mʋ brɛ́ lafʋn ánɩ́ mɛ́dalɩ ɔyɩ́ ánfɩtɔ yɔ́ mʋ Sɩ wá. Ɔlɔdwɛ ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋgyi mʋ klɛ ɔsʋlʋ́sʋ nfɩ ámʋ alɩɩ yɔ́fʋn mʋ owukɛ́.
Mʋa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ befia ntʋ́pwɛ atɔ́ ogyíkpá. Alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ á, ɔbʋnsám lawúna wie Simon Iskariot mʋ bi Yuda klʋntɔ ánɩ́ ɔyɛ́lɛ Yesu ha.
Yesu yin ánɩ́ mʋ Sɩ lɔ́pʋ tógyítɔ́ wá mʋ ɩbɩtɔ. Oyin ánɩ́ Bulu wá motsu ba, mʋ wá méyinkí yɔ́ nɩ́.
Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛlɛ ɩbɩ ɔlɛpɛ ámʋtɔ, ɔlɔkʋsʋ́ wɔ́ɩ́ mʋ atadɩɛ tswɩ, tsú ɔsan sába.
Ɔlɛtsɛɩ́ ntsu wá onuwétɔ́, olefi asɩ ɔdɛ mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ ayabiasɩ fwɩ. Ɔfwɩ́ ɔmáyín a, alapʋ́ mʋ osíétɔ́ ɔsan ámʋ tsítsi mʋ ayabiasɩ.
Brɛ́á ɩlɔtʋ Simon Petro a, ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ Yesu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ Wíé, fʋ́ ɔbɔ́fwɩ mɩ́ ayabiasɩ?”
Yesu lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Fʋmóonu tɔ́ ánfɩ ndɛbwɛ ánfɩ asɩ séi. Ɔma asa fóbonu mʋ́ asɩ.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ Petro lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ó-o! Mméesi, afʋfwɩ mɩ́ ayabiasɩ ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ.” Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ mmɔfwɩ fʋ́ ayabiasɩ á, fʋméenya ogyíkpa mɩ́ wá.”
Simon Petro lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ Wíé, megyí mɩ́ ayabi nkʋlɛ. Wuna fwɩ mɩ́ ɩbɩ pʋ́ mɩ́ nwuntɔ ɛ́.”
Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔhá ánɩ́ alabie ntsu mɛ́trá hián ntsubíe. Mboún mʋ ayabiasɩ fwɩ pɛ́, tsúfɛ́ alalɩn dodo. Mlɩ ɩwɩ lalɩn, támɛ megyí mlɩ fɛ́ɛ́.”
(Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ alɩ, tsúfɛ́ oyin ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔbɛ́lɛ mʋ há. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛblɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Megyí mlɩ fɛ́ɛ́ lálɩn” nɩ.)
Brɛ́á ɔlɔfwɩ amʋ́ ayabiasɩ tá á, ɔlɛlatsú mʋ atadɩɛ wá, yínkí yétsiá ɔpʋ́nʋ́ ámʋ asɩ. Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩlanú ɩtɔ́ ánfɩ nabwɛ́ há mlɩ ánfɩ asɩ?
Mlɩtɛtɩ́ mɩ́ ‘Osunápʋ́,’ mlɩtɛtɩ́ mɩ́ ‘Owíé.’ Mʋ́ ɔkpa nɩ́, tsúfɛ́ mʋ́ ngyi nɩ́.
Nɩ́ mɩ́ ánɩ́ ngyi mlɩ osunápʋ́ pʋ́ mlɩ Wíe, nafwɩ́ mlɩ ayabiasɩ á, mʋ́mʋ́ ilehián ánɩ́ mlɩ ɛ́ mlɔ́fwɩ mlɩ aba ayabiasɩ.
Nabwɛ́ súná mlɩ, mɛ́nɩ mlɔ́bwɛ mʋ́ alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ nabwɛ́ mʋ́ há mlɩ ámʋ.
Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa. Osúmpʋ́ ɔkʋkʋ mɔ́dʋn mʋ wie. Alɩ kɛ́n sumbí ɔyɔpʋ́ mɔ́dʋn ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔlɔwa mʋ nɩ.
Ɩ́nɩá mlɩlabɩ́ ɔnɔkwalɩ anfɩ á, Bulu obóyulá mlɩ nɩ́ mlegyi mʋ́sʋ́.

“Megyí mlɩ fɛ́ɛ́ ɩwɩ asʋ́n ndɛblɩ́. Tsúfɛ́ nyin ahá ánɩ́ nalɛ́. Támɛ lehián ánɩ́ Bulu asʋ́n ánfɩ ɩbɛ́ba mʋ́tɔ́. Asʋ́n ámʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ mɩ́a mʋnyɔ anɩdɛ́ ɩbɩ wa ɔlɛpɛtɔ ámʋ lakʋ́sʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́ mɩ́sʋ́.’
Ndɛ mlɩ bláa séi asa ɩba, mɛ́nɩ nɩ́ ɩbá á, mlɔ́hɔ mɩ gyi ánɩ́ mɩ́gyí ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ mbɛ́ɛ ngyi ámʋ nɩ.
Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa. Ɔhagyíɔha ánɩ́ ɔlɔhɔ ɔhá ánɩ́ nɔwa sumbí lahɔ mɩ. Alɩ kɛ́n ɔhagyíɔha ánɩ́ ɔlɔhɔ mɩ lahɔ mɩ́ Sɩ́ ámʋ ɔlɔwa mɩ́ sɩ́sɩ́ ámʋ ɛ́ nɩ́.”
Yesu Lɛ Há
Brɛ́á Yesu lɛ́blɩ́ asʋ́n ánfɩ tá á, asʋ́n ɩhɩ́ɛ́ dɛ mʋ háan mʋ klʋntɔ. Mʋ́ sʋ olowunáa kpa mʋ́ tati ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa, mlɩtɔ ɔkʋlɛ ɔbɛ́lɛ mɩ́ há.”
Akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɛkpɛlɛ́ kɩ aba ansɩ́tɔ́, tsúfɛ́ bʋmeyín amʋ́tɔ́ ɔmʋá ɔdɛ.
Akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋtɔ ɔkʋlɛá otsie mantáa Yesu, gyí ɔmʋá Yesu tɛhɩ́ɛ́ dwɛ́ nɩ́.
Mʋ́ sʋ Simon Petro lóbun mʋ ansíbi ɔbɛ́ɛ, ɔfɩ́tɛ mʋ ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔbɛ́lɛ mʋ há.
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔkasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ léyinkí kpɩ́sá Yesusʋ, fɩ́tɛ́ mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ Wíé, ma ɔbɛ́lɛ fʋ́ há?”
Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ nébia bodobodo, pʋ́dá oputsútɔ́ há ámʋ gyí mʋ nɩ.” Ɩnʋ olebia bodobodo pʋ́dá oputsútɔ́ há Yuda, ogyi Simon Iskariot mʋ bi.
Olenya hɔ mʋ́ alɩ, Ɔbʋnsám lówie mʋtɔ. Mʋ́ sʋ Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Bwɛ tɔ́á fʋdekléá fɔ́bwɛ sasa!”
Ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋtsie ɔpʋ́nʋ́ ámʋ asɩ ámʋtɔ ɔkʋkʋ mɛ́bɩ tɔ́á sʋá Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ asʋ́n ánfɩ.
Amʋ́tɔ́ akʋ bʋkɩ bɛɛ, Yuda gyí amʋ́ sikasʋ ɔkɩ́pʋ. Fíalɩ Yesu dɛ́ mʋ bláa ɔbɛ́ɛ, ɔyɔ́hɔ atɔ́á bɔ́pʋgyi nkɛ ámʋ, ntɛ́ɛ ɔpʋ́ʋ tɔkʋ ya ahiánfɔ.
Yuda lénya hɔ bodobodo amʋ alɩ́, ɔlɛdalɩ. Owí latá alɩ brɛ́ ámʋ.
Mbla Pɔpwɛ
Yuda lénya dálɩ obuto ɩnʋ alɩ Yesu lɛ́blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Brɛ́á Mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ numnyam bɛ́lɩn ɔwan nɩ́. Bulu ɔbɔ́tsʋn mɩsʋ lɛ́ mʋ numnyam ɔwan.
Nɩ́ ɔtsʋn mɩsʋ lɛ́ mʋ numnyam ɔwan á, alɩ kɛ́n ɔbɔ́tsʋn mʋ ɩwɩsʋ lɛ́ mɩ́ numnyam ɔwan nɩ́. Ɔbɔ́wa mɩ́ numnyam ɩnʋnʋ.
Mɩ́ abí, mmɛ́ɛtrá tsiá mlɩ wá, wá ɔpá. Mlódunká mɩ́. Alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ nɛbláa Yudafɔ ahandɛ amʋ mbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mlɩmɛ́ɛtalɩ́ ba ɔtɩ́nɛ́á nɔyɔ́ ámʋ’ a, alɩ kɛ́n ndɛ mlɩ bláa mlɩ ɛ́ nɩ́.
Mbla pɔpwɛ ndɛwa há mlɩ mbɛ́ɛ, mlɩdwɛ aba. Alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ nɔdwɛ mlɩ ámʋ a, alɩ kɛ́n mlɩpʋ́ ɔdwɛ ámʋ dwɛ mlɩ aba nɩ́.
Nɩ́ mlɩdɛ́ aba dwɛ á, ibósuná ahá fɛ́ɛ́ ánɩ́ mɩ́ akasɩ́pʋ́ mlɩgyí.”
Petro Ɔbɔ́swɩɩ́ Ɔbɛ́ɛ Mʋmeyín Yesu
Simon Petro lɛ́fɩtɛ́ Yesu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ Wíé, nkʋ́nʋ fɔyɔ́?” Yesu lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔtɩ́nɛ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ nɔyɔ́ ámʋ a, fʋmɛ́ɛtalɩ́ buo mɩ yɔ́ ɩnʋ séi. Támɛ ɔma a, fóbobuo mɩ.”
Petro lɛ́fɩtɛ́ mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ Wíé, ntogyi sʋ́ mmɛ́ɛtalɩ́ buo fʋ séi. Nówu fʋ́ sʋ!”
Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Fówu mɩ́ sʋ? Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ fʋ́ bláa. Fɔ́swɩɩ́ pʋ́ ɩbɩ wá ogyá tse sa fɛɛ fʋmeyín mɩ́ asa batɛ ɔbɛ́lɛ ɔnɔ́.”
